selection_reasoning: These 4 tasks form a coherent multi-hop exploration and interaction sequence. The player must first locate polished diorite stairs before they can mine them (find → mine dependency). The red banner serves as a visual landmark/waypoint that guides the player toward the shulker box location, creating a navigation chain. The shulker box is the final goal, requiring the player to have navigated through the scene. This creates a DAG with two branches: one exploration-mining branch (find stairs → mine stairs) and one navigation-interaction branch (find banner → open shulker box), with the mining branch also feeding into the shulker box task since the mined stairs area reveals the path to the banner/shulker box area.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the polished diorite stairs on the front face of the building (spawn-relative center ~6, ~1, ~3) and face toward them. The stairs are visible from outside the building, so max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 allow detection when the player can see them.

Uses inventory_has because when polished diorite stairs are mined with a pickaxe, they drop themselves as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The player starts with no polished_diorite_stairs in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red banner is inside the building at spawn-relative (~6, ~0, ~7). The player must enter the building (after mining the stairs) and face the banner. max_distance=5 ensures the player is actually inside or at the entrance, and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking at it.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the evaluator's info dict does not have a reliable 'container_opened' event. Opening a shulker box requires the player to be adjacent to it and facing it (right-click interaction). The shulker box is at spawn-relative (~5, ~0, ~6). Using max_distance=2 ensures the player is right next to it (interaction range), and facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are oriented toward it, which is the prerequisite posture for opening. This is the most reliable checkable proxy for the open action.

Inside the sealed room is a red banner against the back wall and a purple shulker box on the floor. The player spawns with a diamond pickaxe to mine the stairs.
